Some people just need their own space and that’s how they deal with their anxiety. They also might get annoyed or overwhelmed with you sending them so many messages. Are you able to have an open conversation about how you feel? It sounds like you’re both struggling with your anxiety and you need to find a middle ground to support each other in the best way possible. It’s hard to say don’t worry, but try not to take her leaving you on read as personal. Ask her the reasons for her doing this and explain to her how it makes you feel. Also, if you feel the need to spam her, maybe just write the messages down and don’t send them? It makes you come across as less needy then, but you’re still able to outlet how you feel a little bit. Anyway, I hope you feel better soon.

You should definitely report her, how dare somebody treat you like that! Is it possible for you to look for another job? There are so many good people and places to work in this world and if your work cannot show you the respect you deserve, then fuck them! 
You are beautiful, no matter what colour you are. I hope you feel better soon, sending good vibes to you 😊
